exact_statement:
theorem signed_occurrence_moment_bound :
    ∃ η₀ : ℝ, 0 < η₀ ∧
      ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → η < η₀ →
        ∃ κ₀ : ℝ, 0 < κ₀ ∧ κ₀ < η / 256 ∧
          ∀ κ : ℝ, 0 < κ → κ < κ₀ →
            ∃ r : ℕ, 1 ≤ r ∧
              ∀ d : ℕ, 1 ≤ d →
                ∀ lam : Partition (2 ^ d),
                  ∀ (u v l : ℕ) (h : u + v + l = 2 ^ d)
                    (α : Partition u) (β : Partition v) (γ : Partition l),
                    SignedOccurrence h α β γ lam →
                      logMoment (weightedMoment lam r) ≤
                        ((coefficient η d * signedEntropy α β +
                            remainderBudget κ d l : ℝ) : EReal)
